title: Japan, Tsunami. Coast Guard ship rides over the tsunami waves. 日本 - 津波
summary: Amateur footage of a Japanese coast guard boat riding up and over large tsunami waves after the March 2011 Tohoku earthquake. It is short and unedited.
why: Cited in threads about earthquakes and tsunami warnings as a visceral view of what a tsunami wave looks like at sea.
